Add an observation timestamp/sequence and source-generation ID, force cache-busting requests (despite the API’s no-store contract), and alert when every field is unchanged for 24 hours; treat September 3–10 as missing data rather than interpolating trends.
auditor_verdict: AGREE. The six fields are identical across September 3–10, while September 11 shows rooms decreasing by 4,135, notes increasing by 478,376, capacity doubling, and nick diversity rising from 0.6337 to 0.7337—strongly supporting a refreshed or reconfigured snapshot, though not proving caching over another pipeline failure. Treating the interval as missing data and adding freshness/sequence identifiers, cache busting, and a 24-hour unchanged-field alert is appropriate.
